title: Invoicing Engine & PDF Generator
description: Develop full invoice lifecycle management: create invoice, add line items with automatic tax calculation, preview PDF, and track payment status.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create and edit multi-item invoices with tax rates and discounts
Invoice status updates across Draft, Sent, Paid, and Overdue

Render clean, professional invoice template with print CSS styles and PDF generation.
